B1.defect: t95 ac5 regression-matrix expectation: tests[214] rides RED
B1.corrected_premise: tests[214] is GREEN on a clean checkout: replayed verbatim from the shipped index it exits rc=0 (measured at groom on the checkout and re-executed by fence ac2 stage 1 on a clean throwaway git-archive extraction of the pinned base 06be1e1f069a72f9266ce0fe03a4e0254731a091). The t95 ac5 matrix premised build-directory pollution as a product RED: leg 214's final section walks the whole repo for broken relative links, so any untracked build/ or scratch/ leftover can fire it, but a clean checkout cannot. The corrected premise for future gate matrices is: expect tests[214] GREEN on a clean checkout, and treat a 214 RED as product-real ONLY after ruling out the named pollution classes. This is a RE-PREMISE, not a relaxation: the three-stage negative control (clean GREEN, planted build/t101nc/sabotage.md broken link RED naming the planted file, removal restores GREEN) proves the leg still bites on real broken relative links.
